evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources.
